mcp_tools.name: list_my_orgs
mcp_tools.why_safe: Lists only orgs the grant's person runs, within the key's scope.

mcp_tools.name: whats_next
mcp_tools.why_safe: Reads the next course/routine step and channel board for the settled org only.

mcp_tools.name: routine_steps
mcp_tools.why_safe: Never enrols; reads only the person's own course state.

mcp_tools.name: org_summary
mcp_tools.why_safe: Org identity and setup status for an org the person runs.

mcp_tools.name: entry_status
mcp_tools.why_safe: Only agent-exposed, never appOnly, catalogue entries.

mcp_tools.name: list_pages
mcp_tools.why_safe: Org comes from the grant and the query is keyed by org_id.

mcp_tools.name: read_page
mcp_tools.why_safe: Returns the stored document with its version; member text fenced as untrusted.

mcp_tools.name: find_fields
mcp_tools.validates_against: FieldDescriptor generator over page doc and registries
mcp_tools.why_safe: Returns ids and limits; values are fenced and never include other orgs.

mcp_tools.name: propose_page_patch
mcp_tools.validates_against: block manifest, validatePage, cleanStyle/cleanCustomCss, sanitizeRichValues, size cap, baseVersion == updatedAt
mcp_tools.why_safe: Ops apply to a copy saved as a draft row; the live page changes only when a person presses Publish.

mcp_tools.name: set_field
mcp_tools.validates_against: descriptor limits via shared checkValue + sanitiser
mcp_tools.why_safe: Only fields whose store has a draft state; live copy stays human-only.

mcp_tools.name: open_surface
mcp_tools.why_safe: Returns a link for the person to open; nothing opens or changes server-side.

mcp_tools.name: run_action
mcp_tools.validates_against: AGENT_DRAFT_IDS and the runner's zod input
mcp_tools.why_safe: Only catalogue entries marked draft (writes drafts and additions only), audited as ai.

lms_anchors.what: data-eac-anchor=<catalogue entry id> on the real control; dock outlines it after Take me there
?surface=<descriptor> link built from an entry's address, plus the ?eac-step return ticket
A lesson step names a catalogue entry (settings.task id, scope, params); done is derived from its status
Pushed completion after a successful run so the host re-checks the steps naming that entry
[data-field] elements already carry data-fields-ok when declared; usable as an outline target
Anchor values field:<fieldId> and node:<nodeId> so a step can point at one heading
?eac-edit=field:<id> opens the Fields lens focused on that field
Step done when an action_events row exists for the field's save action with that fieldId
